title: fix(app-shell,react,plugin-detail): fold an override-only admin's approval levers into one menu and draw Recall once
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Yb7oXSyx8Wfrc3ohS5yGJm)_

Fixes #25877

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

The `Clause-②` arm is the claim's ruling: one optional member is added to the exported `InlineEditContext` value (and to `InlineEditProvider`'s props) of `@object-ui/react`, which widens its public type surface and narrows nothing. The member is optional so that every existing host keeps its behaviour: absent means `false`, and then the DetailView approval band draws its own Recall exactly as before. A host sets it only when it draws the request's declared Recall itself.

## What changes

Placement only. Who may override, what an override records, the override notice each lever shows and the request each lever sends are unchanged.

- **Record page, admin who is not the approver** (`viewer.can_act: false`, `viewer.can_override: true`): the approval bar above the title is now one line: a Pending badge with "Waiting on" and the pending approvers by name, the levers with no override arm as buttons (Reply, for the submitter), and one amber "Admin override" menu holding every lever the override flag admits (Override Approve, Override Reject, Override Reassign, and Recall, whose gate ORs the flag in too). The folded set is read off each action's own `visible` gate (`actionAdmittedByOverride`), not off a name list. The submitter's own Recall stays the plain Recall inside the menu; a non-submitter admin sees Override Recall, as before.
- **Record page, approver**: unchanged (`foldOverrides` folds nothing for a viewer who can act).
- **Recall drawn once**: `DeclaredActionsBar` reports which declared actions it actually draws (new optional `onDrawnActionsChange`, after the capability gate and each action's `visible` verdict; folded levers report through a visibility probe while their menu is closed). While it draws `approval_recall`, the record page sets `approvalRecallDrawnByHost`, and the DetailView approval band (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`) keeps its lock badge and tally only. Read off what the bar draws, not off whether it is mounted: before the request definition loads, or on a backend that sends no `viewer` block (every declared gate fails closed), the bar draws no Recall and the band stays the submitter's lever.
- The override menu appears only once a folded lever is shown, so a set whose every gate says no leaves no empty menu.
- `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` re-recorded on the merged tree (`node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`); `sdui.manifest.json` itself is byte-identical.

Files: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/DeclaredActionsBar.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`, `ui/packages/react/src/context/InlineEditContext.tsx`, `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx` (seat 2's package, held by this card with seat 2's knowledge), tests beside each, root changeset (patch for `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/react`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail`).

## Verification

All on head `df86fb71` (main `39a78b15` merged in):

```
$ cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 PATHS   # 101 files under the verify lock
 Test Files  101 passed (101)
      Tests  728 passed (728)
$ pnpm --filter @object-ui/react --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0
```

The 101 files are every `RecordDetailView.*`, `RecordApprovalsPanel.*` and `DeclaredActionsBar.*` test in app-shell, every `DetailView.*` test in plugin-detail, and the `InlineEditContext` / `resolveApprovalLock` tests in react. They include `RecordDetailView.recordOpenRequests-12701`, whose control case ("every approvals consumer still shows its state") is what moved the signal from "bar mounted" to "bar draws Recall". New tests:

- `app-shell/src/views/__tests__/DeclaredActionsBar.foldOverrides-25877.test.tsx` (8): the fold, the status line, Reply stays a button, menu order and labels, a folded lever still dispatches with its override notice, the approver's bar unchanged, no change without `foldOverrides`, the drawn-actions report (menu closed, approver set, unmount), no empty menu.
- `plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailView.approvalRecallHostDrawn-25877.test.tsx` (3): signal on, absent, and toggled.
- `RecordDetailView.approvalRecallGate.test.tsx` (+3, page to band seam): the signal is true while the bar draws Recall, false on a backend with no `viewer` block, false with no approvals API.
- `RecordDetailView.approvalDeclaredActions.test.tsx`: the override-admin case now opens the menu to find its three levers.

The first type-check run on the merged tree failed once in `metadata-admin/useMonacoFallback.ts` (`configureBundledMonaco` missing from a `plugin-editor` dist built before #25993 merged); after `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build` all three packages pass. That file is not in this diff.

Reverse verification, each mutation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with its on-disk proof and a byte-identical restore to `HEAD` (tests resolve `@object-ui/*` to source, so no rebuild leg):

| mutation | went red |
|---|---|
| band: drop the `approvalRecallDrawnByHost` term from the Recall condition | 2 of 3 in `DetailView.approvalRecallHostDrawn-25877` |
| bar: never fold (`false && foldOverrides …`) | 3 of 8 in `DeclaredActionsBar.foldOverrides-25877` |
| bar: always draw the menu trigger | "draws no menu when every folded lever is hidden by its own gate" |
| page: `approvalRecallDrawnByHost={false}` | "tells the band the page draws recall while the decision bar draws it" |
| page: signal on mount instead of on drawn (`&&` to `\|\|`) | "leaves the band its recall when the bar is up but draws none" |

Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 46 commands for this diff (10 paths vs merge base `39a78b15`); every one exited 0 on the merged tree, including `check-sdui-manifest.mjs` after the re-record. `--ran` reconciliation: "46 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 46 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". After the last commit (changeset wording only) the changeset-reading gates were re-run and exited 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **Placement reading.** The card says 「标题旁一个「…」菜单」. The menu sits where the bar was, on the line above the title, and is not injected into `page:header`; the seat's claim records this reading.
- **Status wording.** The line reuses existing bundle keys (`approvalsInbox.statusPending`, `approvalsInbox.waitingOn`, `approvalsInbox.approverNameSeparator`, `approvalsInbox.viaOverrideChip` for the menu's name), so in zh-CN it reads 「待审批」 + 「等待以下审批人」 + names rather than the card's literal 「审批中 · 等待 X」. A dedicated sentence key would touch `ui/packages/i18n` in ten locales, outside this card's file surface. carrier: none.
- **Menu items keep the menu open while the lever's own dialog runs** (`preventDefault` on select), the same shape as the page header's overflow items in `PageHeaderActions`.
- **Narrowed local run.** `ui/packages/app-shell` has about 1700 test files; locally only the files named after the touched components ran (listed under Verification). The full package is CI `Test Core`'s.
